b: Ugly Stik is wrapping up its 50th anniversary celebration with a bass tournament where every angler fishes in a Santa suit. The World’s Largest Santa Claus Bass Tournament returns to North Carolina’s Lake Norman on Saturday, Dec. 12, bringing anglers together for a day of competitive fishing, holiday fun and giving back. Registration for the event closes Nov. 30.

The one-day tournament will feature both boat and kayak divisions, with anglers competing for cash prizes and bragging rights. The first-place boat team will take home $5,000, while the top kayak angler will earn $2,500. All pre-registered anglers will receive a Santa suit along with fishing gear from Ugly Stik, Berkley and Plano, valued at $100.

“We’ve spent the year celebrating 50 years of America’s favorite fishing rod, and we can’t think of a better way to wrap it up than with a lake full of Santas,” said Sherri Gasparon, Director of Marketing for Ugly Stik. “Ugly Stik fans know how to have a good time, and this tournament brings together the holiday spirit, our love of fishing and an opportunity to give back to veterans through Reel Heroes.”
Tournament proceeds will benefit Reel Heroes, a nonprofit chapter of Purple Heart Homes that changes veterans’ lives through the outdoors and helps ensure they have a safe place to call home.

The tournament will launch from Pinnacle Access Area on River Highway in Mooresville, North Carolina. Entry fees are $200 per two-person boat team and $100 for kayak anglers, with an additional $10 big bass pot available.
